analysis_plot_local_changes: Shortened decode-memory y label to Peak total VRAM (GiB); horizontal ticks for single panels, angled ticks retained for narrow facets. Exact source hashes identify these rendering changes.
supplements: All nine metrics have three per-method facets with full control and 80/50/25 percent conditions.

validation.strict_shared_history_analysis: passed for all five source runs
validation.actual_data_layout_boundary_checks: Every visible text label fits the canvas in main decode throughput, main decode peak, supplementary decode peak and main prefill peak views.

interpretation: At 50 percent retention, median decode throughput across 2k to 16k changes from 39.361 to 35.208 tokens/s for full KV, 35.906 to 29.702 for StreamingLLM, 23.023 to 1.571 for R-KV, and 29.590 to 22.574 for AgentKV. This is a measured single-history cost comparison, not task quality.

Ordinary decode-pass peak VRAM at 50 percent is non-monotone for R-KV: 21.534, 22.458, 29.747, 24.804 and 27.773 GiB. Full, StreamingLLM and AgentKV remain around 21 GiB under the same preallocated pool. Lower occupied KV does not imply proportionally lower total VRAM in this implementation.

All first repetitions remain in the raw points, ranges and all-three medians. StreamingLLM first-use spread and smaller later-repeat variation remain visible; ranges are not confidence intervals or proof of steady performance.
Occupied KV is a supporting accounting view: compressed methods at equal retention coincide by construction. It must not be presented as a method difference.
Selection and compaction are synchronized whole instrumented prefix-plus-continuation replay totals, not per-token rates, and cannot be added again to inference elapsed.
scope_limits: One historical train/dev token sequence with forced output tokens; no task tools or evaluator execute.
Technical repetitions are not independent task samples or task-bootstrap uncertainty.
Fixed condition order, standard synthetic warmup, persistent compilation caches and all first repetitions are preserved; no per-shape warmup or timing rerun was added.
GPU allocation was exclusive to one timing workload; no concurrency claim is made about unrelated storage services.
A6000 40 GiB is an authorized diagnostic setup, not a frozen final task evaluation.
Numerical-reference failures remain preserved; this cost grid is not final-study model-accuracy qualification.

separate_infeasibility.interpretation: Preserved separately and excluded before this complete repeated grid was declared. Not pooled with 64-decode timing; no free replacement, cap change or hidden failed condition.
